title: The Shepherd Finds His Sheep
old_p1: Many families in Israel kept sheep. A shepherd is a person who cares for sheep, finds them food and water, and keeps them safe.
The leaders of Israel were supposed to care for the people like shepherds, but they did not. So Heavenly Father said, “I myself will search for my sheep.” His people were His sheep.
old_p2: When His sheep were scattered on a cloudy, dark day, He would go find every one. He would bring them home to green hills by the rivers.
He promised to bring back the lost one, wrap up the hurt one like a bandage, and make the weak one strong. Later, Jesus said, “I am the good shepherd.”
You are one of His little lambs. Tonight you can snuggle in, safe and loved, because He knows where you are.
p1: A good shepherd takes care of his sheep. He finds them grass to eat and keeps them safe.
Israel’s leaders did not care for the people that way. The people were like lost sheep, scattered on a cloudy, dark day.
Heavenly Father told Ezekiel, “I myself will look for my sheep. I will find them.”
p2: He promised to bring the lost ones home to green grass. He would wrap up the hurt ones, like a bandage on a scraped knee. He would make the weak ones strong. Many years later, Jesus said, “I am the good shepherd.”
You are one of Heavenly Father’s little lambs. He knows your name. Snuggle in and feel safe tonight. The Good Shepherd takes care of you.
